study_notes.observed: Sep 2025 Seven Seas frontage (white render with staggered punched windows over a two-storey grey split-face base, metal-canopied stoops, stepped segments); Nov 2025 NW corner (4-storey white unit block with dark window bands and storefront base, grey-framed two-storey glazed entrance box on the taller wing, stepped units along the paseo); undated Apple overhead: 4-storey WSW block and 7-storey ENE block around a landscaped courtyard, PV strip on the WSW block.
study_notes.inferred: WSW paseo units beyond the first few, SSE end (side entrance, south-link garage/service door/louvres) and courtyard faces. Storey heights, bay cadence, step depths, stagger and roof items are production inference.
study_notes.footprint: Frozen OSM quadrilateral kept as the outer ring. The ENE block steps in a sawtooth above a continuous two-storey base on the footprint line; WSW units step 0.7 m with paved wedges, so every outer extent stays the frozen edge. Floor at the median frozen terrain along the Seven Seas front; the block plinth shows where the paseo terrain drops.
